verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents object cloning of databases and schemas, with clones inheriting privileges on child objects (snowflake-docs-67, snowflake-docs-71), and a community user cites cloning as a valued feature (snowflake-comm-2). Cloning is the product's own mechanism for spinning up a separate copy to test against, and RBAC can scope what a test role can reach (snowflake-docs-8). However, the evidence never explicitly frames cloning as a sandbox or test-environment workflow, and never states that changes to a clone leave production untouched. missing for 10: explicit documentation of clone-based dev/test sandboxes and their isolation from production, a zero-copy/cost description, agent-specific sandbox guidance, hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.
